title: DIVINE INTUITION — Pune Racecourse
excerpt: A six-year-old horse panicked in the starting gate at Pune racecourse, suffering visible injury before the race even began.
content:
Moments before the start of the race at Pune racecourse on 21 September 2025, DIVINE INTUITION (6-year-old) panicked inside the starting stall.

He reared up and fell backwards. He struggled to get back on his feet. His suffering and fear were caught on the racing video.

When examined, he was found bleeding from his left nostril.

https://youtu.be/9GpCnZKtf_Q?si=TRIZWWYwoiAEGWFF

Injuries at the starting gates are all too common. Horses are hardwired to avoid tight, enclosed spaces where they can’t see escape routes. A starting gate is narrow, metallic, loud, and confining; everything that triggers a horse’s flight instinct. The clanging of the metal gates, shouting handlers, loudspeakers, and the presence of other horses all increase anxiety. When the gates open suddenly with a loud bang, many horses panic, rear, or leap sideways.

Horses that hesitate to enter are often pushed, tugged, or hit to enter the stall. Some are even fitted with blinkers or hoods to reduce resistance, and it is not to calm them, but to confuse or desensitize them.

Horses don’t choose to race. They’re confined, coerced, and terrorised to do so.

And, this is what the horseracing industry hides behind glamour and gambling.

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.

Boycott horseracing

Source: Indiarace.com and RWITC

title: SUPERLUMINAL — Killed at Pune Racecourse
excerpt: A four-year-old filly was killed after suffering a catastrophic breakdown during a race at Pune.
content:
RIP SUPERLUMINAL – a 4 year old filly killed on 12th October 2025 at Pune racecourse.

The race day report read, “Passing the 500 metres, SUPERLUMINAL (R. Shelar) lost its footing, broke down and dislodged its rider, the filly was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. and was found to be recumbent with broken left fore radius bone with open fracture which was not repairable. As such, with the due consent of Trainer Ivor Fernandes the filly was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.”

https://youtu.be/SZghhNusAQo?si=m5lRrfPyR1v2yCDZ

Her death was NOT HUMANE!

Her death was blood wetting the grass.

Her death was cries of agony muted by the cheers.

Her death was fear of dying without ever being able to run free.

This vile, selfish, and despicable atrocity towards helpless horses is what horseracing truly is.

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.

title: Pune Protest Revisit — Demand to Abolish Horseracing
excerpt: Animal liberation activists gathered again in Pune to demand the complete abolition of horse racing in India.
content:
Animal Liberation Activists Protested Against Horseracing After the Killing of Superluminal

https://youtube.com/shorts/T1nmky-mHJI?si=r9H0MU--bL1gkQp-

On the 2nd of November, 2025, in front of the Pune racecourse, in a powerful show of solidarity, a group of animal liberation activists gathered to demand the complete abolition of horse racing, a.k.a. enslavement of horses in India. The protest was jointly organized by Erase Horseracing India and Animal Liberation Activists from Pune, following the recent tragic killing of Superluminal, a four-year-old racehorse who suffered a broken left foreleg during a “race” at the Pune Racecourse and was subsequently killed on October 12th, 2025.

The protest began with a short recitation on the life and suffering of Superluminal in the horse racing industry by liberationist Sahil, drawing attention to the exploitation and violence hidden behind the glamour and gambling of horse racing.

The protestors were holding placards calling out the objectification and enslavement of horses and then chanted slogans in English, Hindi, and Marathi.

“Shattered limbs and heart attacks. Close down these racetracks”

"आवाज उठाये कब तक? चाबुक चलेगा जब तक!"

"शर्यत सोडा, न्याय जोडा!"

"नुसतच म्हणतात काळजी हाय, पैशे देतात तोडायला पाय"

Leaflets detailing the industry’s cruel practices were distributed to the public, pressing them not to bet, attend, or support horse racing.

“Superluminal’s death is not an “unfortunate accident”, it’s the inevitable outcome of an industry built on the oppression and exploitation of sentient beings,” said Aakash, one of the protesters leading the slogans.

"सुपरल्युमिनलचा मृत्यू हा "दुर्दैवी अपघात" नाही, तर तो संवेदनशील प्राण्यांच्या अत्याचार आणि शोषणावर उभारलेल्या उद्योगाचा अपरिहार्य परिणाम आहे," असे घोषणाबाजीचे नेतृत्व करणारा निदर्शक आकाश म्हणाला.

“Horses are confined for over 21 hours a day, whipped into submission, and killed or discarded as waste when no longer profitable. Research shows that post-race, 99% of the racehorses suffer from Exercise Induced Pulmonary Haemorrhage (EIPH), which is bleeding in their lungs. If a sport harms its “athletes” (slaves) to this extent, then the only just action is to eradicate it,” said Nitharshni from Erase Horseracing India.

Another activist added, “If we truly care about animals, we must not turn a blind eye to their exploitation on racetracks. ‘It is high time we end the crime’ and hold the elite class involved in horse racing accountable for the slavery they continue to partake in.”

"अगर हम सचमुच जानवरों की परवाह करते हैं, तो हमें रेसट्रैक पर उनके शोषण को नज़रअंदाज़ नहीं करना चाहिए। 'अब समय आ गया है, हम इस अपराध को जड़ से खत्म करें!'"

“What do we want? Animal Liberation! When do we want it? NOW!” all the activists chanted in unison.

This brutal killing is not an isolated incident. In 2023, Victory Chant, a 4-year-old horse, fell during a “race” and was found to have a fractured right shoulder; murdered. In 2024, Deo Volente, a 3-year-old horse, suffered a hip fracture; murdered. Later the same year, Golden Neil, a 5-year-old horse, broke both fore fetlock joints mid-race; murdered.

वारंवार होणाऱ्या मृत्यूंमुळे घोड्यांच्या शर्यतीतील अंतर्निहित क्रूरता उघड होते, जिथे प्राणघातक दुखापती आणि मृत्यूंना खेळाचा भाग म्हणून नियमितपणे नाकारले जाते.

“In the wake of Superluminal’s death, we are calling for immediate action from the authorities & the stakeholders to abolish horse racing altogether because all the horses involved are victims of enslavement & exploitation for human entertainment,” said the lead protestor, Sahil.

"सुपरल्यूमिनल की मौत के मद्देनज़र, हम अधिकारियों और हितधारकों से घोड़ों की दौड़ को पूरी तरह से खत्म करने के लिए तत्काल कार्रवाई करने का आह्वान कर रहे हैं।"

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.

title: The Truth About the Whip in Horseracing
excerpt: Scientific evidence confirms that horses feel the pain of the whip just as humans would.
content:
20th September 2025

The racing industry wants you to believe that the whip is a “tool.”

But science is clear: horses feel the sting of every strike just like we would.

Horse skin = Human skin

Professor Paul McGreevy’s team found:

No difference in skin thickness between horses & humans

Same concentration of nerve endings

Same sensitivity to pain

📖 Source: McGreevy et al., Animals (2020a)

Horses feel whip pain just like humans.

“This was not surprising, as horses, like humans, need robust yet sensitive skin to respond to touch, say, from flying insects or other horses,” said Professor McGreevy.

If we’d feel the sting of a whip, so do they.

📖 Source: University of Sydney News (November 2020)

What do other experts say?

Whips don’t make horses run faster

Whips don’t improve safety

Whips only cause fear and pain

📖 Sources:

Racing Pulse (September 2025)

Hall et al., J Appl Anim Welf Sci (2008)

McGreevy et al., Animals (2020b)

Whip bans won’t fix racing.

Horses are still exploited, broken, and killed for profit.

Don’t watch. Don’t attend. Don’t bet.

Boycott horseracing.

title: The Unbearable Abuse of Mouth Bits
excerpt: Mouth bits, often defended as tools of communication, are in reality instruments of pain, fear, and control.
content:
14th December 2025

The unbearable abuse of mouth bits. The bit, often defended as a tool of communication, is in reality a cruel instrument of control. They force a horse to wear a bit. Resisting it is made more painful, so the horse eventually gives in.

A 2020 study explains how bits cause intense pain. Try the “Mellor pen test” to feel it for yourself. More details below.

The “Mellor pen-test” is intended to simulate the bit pressure applied to the gums of the horse.

Hold the pen in front of your mouth.

Open your mouth.

Roll your bottom lip down and locate the pen on your gum, below your central incisors.

Now release your lip and with both hands holding the pen, apply compressive pressure to your gum.

How much pain can you withstand?

Now, lying on your back, imagine a bag hanging from the ends of the pen with a 7 kg weight, the maximum for carry-on, and then a 20 kg weight, the maximum for stowed luggage.

This is, however, less than half the maximum force that a horse experiences from the rein in tension.

The 2020 study by David J. Mellor in Animals explained how horses show a strong aversion to bits, which can cause intense breathlessness, panic, and anxiety. The bit’s placement also interferes with a horse’s ability to breathe freely, producing sensations of suffocation that drive fear and distress.

Far from the illusion of a “cooperative” racehorse prancing eagerly at the gate, the behaviours we see — wide eyes, gaping mouths, teeth grinding, salivation, tongue lolling, head shaking, and tail swishing — are not signs of excitement but of agony. These are horses desperately reacting to pain they cannot escape. When the industry calls this “communication,” it conceals a harsh reality: horses are not willing participants but terrified, helpless victims forced to obey through pain.

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.

Boycott horseracing

Link to the article: https://www.mdpi.com/2076-2615/10/4/572

Sources: CPR and TCG Studioz

title: BALTIMORE — I Will Never Again Obey
excerpt: A horse’s voice imagined through poetry, followed by the real incident that exposed her resistance to exploitation.
content:
21st December 2025

THIS. IS. IT. I will never again obey.
These men have made me their prey.
I have endured unspeakable abuse.
They inflict more pain if I refuse.

For eight years, I’ve lived in a tiny room,
Let outside for only a few hours to groom.
There are hundreds more like me,
Living in isolation with no chance to flee.

Here I am, strapped up with a number,
For the 44th time, if I rightly remember.
As I walk through the cheering crowd,
My abusers arrive, all looking so proud.

They say I dare not lift my head,
Nor speak a word, or I’d be dead.
They force sixty kilos on my back,
And a metal bit to keep me on track.

Last time, I was clinging to my life.
Every step I took cut me like a knife.
Burning up, suffocating, and scared,
I ran so fast, but I still wasn’t spared.

This time, I rebel before entering the gate,
Push off the man who controls my fate.
I dare to take back my freedom now,
`Cause it's my right, and I will not bow.

I bolt in the other direction with all my might,
To only see rails, walls and gates sealed tight.
The angry men come chasing after me desperately,
Tired and with nowhere to go, I stand helplessly.

They tie me up and beat me down,
But you think I always wear a crown.
Now you know how this exploitation ends,
For me, my family, and my friends.

They call me by the name BALTIMORE.
They treat me like an object; nothing more.
Yet I will never give up and will always try.
A horse is not a slave; so neither am I.

On 28th November 2025, at the Bangalore racecourse and on the way to the starting gates, “BALTIMORE (an 8-year-old mare), bolted, dropped the rider, and thereafter, ran in an anti-clockwise direction, on the inner sand track.” She was declared “withdrawn” from the race.

A race that would have been her 44th.

A race that would have made her relive her worst fears.

A race that would have even killed her.

So, she fought back. She was defeated. But this won’t end in vain.

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.

Boycott horseracing
